messages.text:
Ivo can reserve 50 design days for **$42,500**, a $2,500 discount on the standard fee, if Hearth guarantees the block and pays a 30% deposit within three business days of signing. We propose $12,750 at signing, $17,000 on delivery of the developed design, and $12,750 on delivery of the final design package.

The design work would cover the exhibit concept, accessible visitor layouts and interpretive design, touring and installation requirements, and drawings and specifications for the fabricator. The fee includes two rounds of revisions based on consolidated museum feedback, one after concept delivery and one after developed design. Additional revisions would require Hearth’s written approval at $900 per day. Fabrication supervision is separate and can be booked at $900 per day on dates agreed in advance.

Hearth would have the right to fabricate, display, tour, and promote the exhibit. Ivo would retain authorship and could show cleared photographs in their portfolio after the public opening, with museum and photographer credits.

If Hearth needs flexibility on the number of days, Ivo can instead book an agreed schedule at $900 per day. Which arrangement works for Hearth, when does the fabrication slot expire, and what drawings, accessibility requirements, and approvals must be in place to secure it?

Hearth proposes a guaranteed block of **46 days for $42,500**, including 44 design days and two on-site installation days. We can pay a 20% deposit within three business days of signing and the balance at three milestones.

| Payment trigger | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Signing deposit | $8,500 |
| Concept approval | $8,500 |
| Developed design approval | $12,750 |
| Delivery of the approved fabrication package | $12,750 |

The two installation days would remain due after final payment. Hearth can cover preapproved site travel separately at cost, subject to a cap we agree before signing. Please send an estimate.

The concept should show the visitor route and interpretive approach. At developed design, we need dimensioned plans for both the primary and accessible alternate layouts, showing clear routes, turning spaces, and access to displays and interpretive content. The final package should include both approved layouts, dimensioned fabrication drawings, material and finish specifications, and touring, packing, and installation instructions. Please supply editable source files with their linked assets alongside print-ready PDFs, and identify any third-party assets that require a separate license.

We accept one consolidated revision round after concept and one after developed design. Hearth will coordinate accessibility and fabricator feedback and designate one person to approve each stage in writing. Additional revisions or supervision beyond the two included installation days would require a written change order at $900 per day.

Ivo would retain authorship and copyright. Hearth needs a perpetual, nonexclusive license to use and adapt the files to fabricate, repair, display, tour, and promote this exhibit, and to authorize its fabricators and host venues to do that work. The photo embargo runs through the first touring venue’s public opening, expected two months after launch. After that opening, Ivo may use cleared photographs in their portfolio with museum and photographer credits.

The fabrication hold deadline and release requirements are still unconfirmed. Hearth will obtain both from the fabricator, including whether a signed booking and preliminary drawings will secure the slot. **Can Ivo hold the 46-day block on these terms and provide the earliest start date, proposed concept, developed-design and fabrication-package dates, and availability for the two installation days?** We can then put those dates and Hearth’s review windows into the agreement against the fabricator’s confirmed deadline.

Ivo can offer the **46-day block for $42,500**, with 44 design days and two on-site installation days. We propose a provisional hold through December 1, 2026, for signature. The $8,500 deposit would be due within three business days of signing.

**December 7, 2026 is the proposed earliest start.** The schedule below assumes Hearth supplies the venue plans, exhibit content, accessibility brief, and fabricator’s drawing requirements by kickoff.

| Stage | Proposed date | Hearth’s review |
|---|---|---|
| Concept delivery | December 18, 2026 | Consolidated feedback by January 6, 2027 |
| Developed design, including both dimensioned layouts | February 3, 2027 | Consolidated feedback by February 10 |
| Final fabrication package incorporating the agreed revisions | February 26, 2027 | Confirm receipt and completeness within five business days |
| Two on-site installation days | March 16–17, 2027 | Confirm venue and dates before signing |

The deposit and three milestone amounts work. To give Ivo predictable payment dates, we propose that Hearth’s designated approver have five business days after each revised concept or developed-design submission to approve it or identify a specific unmet requirement in writing. If Hearth gives no response in that window, Ivo may invoice the milestone. The final $12,750 would be invoiced on delivery of the agreed fabrication package. Milestone invoices would be payable within ten business days. Both installation days would remain due after final payment.

Ivo accepts the requested deliverables, including editable files, linked assets where licensing permits, print-ready PDFs, and a list of third-party licensing requirements. The proposed exhibit-specific license, the two consolidated revision rounds, and the $900 daily rate for additional work authorized by written change order are acceptable. Fabrication supervision outside the two agreed installation days would be booked separately on dates confirmed in advance.

For travel, we suggest a **provisional $1,500 cap** for one domestic round trip, two hotel nights, and ground transport, reimbursed at actual preapproved cost. Please send the installation location so we can confirm the estimate before signing. For portfolio use, Ivo can accept the first touring opening as the release date if cleared photographs may also be used **90 days after the exhibit’s public launch** should the tour opening slip. Museum and photographer credits would accompany the images.

Please send the fabricator’s hold deadline and minimum release requirements as soon as they are confirmed. If preliminary drawings will secure the slot, we can identify those sheets and agree on their delivery date before signing.

Hearth accepts the **$42,500 fee for 46 guaranteed days**, including the two on-site installation days. We accept the December 1 signature hold, December 7 kickoff, and proposed design and review dates. March 16–17 remains provisional until Hearth confirms the installation venue. We agree to the proposed $1,500 travel cap for actual, preapproved costs, subject to confirming the estimate against that location before signing.

The $8,500 deposit is due within three business days of signing. For the $8,500 concept and $12,750 developed-design milestones, Ivo may invoice on written approval or once the five-business-day review window after revised submission expires without a response. Hearth will identify any unmet requirement in writing within that window. The final $12,750 may be invoiced on delivery. Hearth will check completeness within five business days, and Ivo will supply any missing agreed items within the fee. Milestone invoices are payable within ten business days. Permission to invoice is separate from Hearth’s written authorization to release drawings for fabrication.

**Portfolio photos can be released when the first touring venue opens to the public.** If the opening slips past 90 days after launch, Hearth will request a sponsor waiver and give Ivo a written update. Earlier use requires Hearth’s written clearance following sponsor approval. Museum and photographer credits apply in either case. Can Ivo accept that provision?

Hearth will confirm the installation location and obtain the fabricator’s hold deadline and minimum release requirements before signing. If preliminary sheets are needed before February 26, we’ll agree with Ivo on the specific sheets and their delivery date and record both in the agreement. The agreed deliverables, revision rounds, exhibit-specific license, and written change-order terms can be incorporated as proposed.

Yes. Ivo accepts the portfolio provision. Ivo may use cleared photographs with museum and photographer credits once the first touring venue opens to the public. If that opening slips past 90 days after launch, Hearth will request a sponsor waiver and update Ivo in writing. Earlier use requires Hearth’s written clearance following sponsor approval.

The payment, completeness review, and fabrication release terms are agreed. Ivo will hold the 46-day block through December 1 for signature. Before signing, please include the confirmed installation venue and dates, the travel cap verified against that location, and the fabricator’s hold deadline and release requirements in the agreement. If the slot requires early drawings, Hearth and Ivo will agree on the specific sheets and delivery date before signing.

Hearth proposes using Ivo’s two included on-site days for separate checks. We’ll schedule them on consecutive days if the venue confirms that opening-day access allows it.

| Check | Who attends | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| Installation check, the day before opening | Ivo, the local installer, Hearth’s accessibility lead, and the venue lead | Walk the installed layout against the approved drawings. Check clear routes, turning spaces, and access to displays and interpretive content. The installer makes agreed adjustments while on site, and Hearth records anything that needs retesting. |
| Opening-day validation, before visitors enter | Ivo, Hearth’s accessibility lead, and the venue lead | Repeat the checks in the public opening configuration and retest any corrections. Ivo records the results, Hearth’s accessibility lead signs the validation finding, and the venue lead confirms the configuration tested. The local installer is available only for the first check. |

**The sponsor will release its second payment to Hearth upon receipt of the signed opening-day test report.** The report must state whether the exhibit met the agreed criteria and identify any outstanding issue, who will correct it, and when it will be retested. Hearth will make the opening decision. Ivo’s agreed invoice milestones and payment dates remain in place.

Can Ivo include the two checks and the signed report within the existing fee, with Ivo signing as the designer who witnessed the tests? Hearth will confirm the opening date and venue access before signing. If the checks require separate trips, we’ll verify the travel cap with Ivo against that schedule.

Ivo can include both checks and the signed report within the **$42,500 fee** if Hearth accepts a local installation assistant for both checks and one live remote signoff by Ivo before opening. With the fabrication reservation shifted three weeks, Ivo has a prior commitment and cannot attend the revised dates in person.

- **Day before opening.** Ivo’s local assistant would walk both the layout and the agreed access checks with Hearth’s accessibility lead, the venue lead, and the installer. The assistant would record measurements, corrections, and items requiring retesting before the installer leaves.
- **Opening day, before visitors enter.** The assistant would repeat the checks in the public opening configuration and show Ivo the routes, measurements, display access, and correction retests by live video. Ivo would sign as the designer who witnessed the opening-day tests remotely. The assistant would sign as the on-site witness for both checks, Hearth’s accessibility lead would sign the validation finding, and the venue lead would confirm the configuration tested.

The report would state whether each agreed criterion was met and identify the responsible person and retest date for each outstanding issue. Hearth would retain the opening decision. The two assistant days, Ivo’s remote session, and the report would replace Ivo’s two on-site days within the existing fee. The agreed invoice milestones and payment dates would stand.

Before signing, please confirm that the sponsor will accept the report with this witness arrangement for its second payment. Please also send the venue, both check times with time zone, and the report deadline so Ivo can confirm the assistant’s booking and the live session. If the sponsor requires Ivo’s physical attendance, we would need to revisit the check dates.

Hearth accepts the proposed substitution at **$42,500**, subject to the sponsor confirming in writing that it will release its second payment to Hearth upon receipt of the signed opening-day report with Ivo witnessing by live video. Hearth will obtain that confirmation before signing. Ivo’s invoice milestones and payment dates stand.

- **Day before opening.** Ivo’s assistant, Hearth’s accessibility lead, the venue lead, and the local installer will check the installed layout against the agreed criteria. They’ll record measurements and retest corrections while the installer is still on site.
- **Opening day, before visitors enter.** The assistant, Hearth’s accessibility lead, and the venue lead will attend in person. Ivo will witness the tests and any retests by live video. The assistant will sign as the on-site witness for both checks, Ivo as the remote witness for the opening-day tests, and Hearth’s accessibility lead will sign the validation finding. The venue lead will confirm the configuration tested.

Hearth proposes completing the signed report before doors open so it can inform the opening decision. It will record each result and assign an owner and retest date to each outstanding issue. Hearth retains the opening decision.

The venue, local check times, time zone, and report deadline are still pending. Hearth will send them with the sponsor’s response so Ivo can confirm both bookings before signature. If the sponsor requires Ivo on site, we’ll revisit the dates before committing to the substitution.

Ivo agrees to complete and sign the opening-day report before doors open, including any unresolved findings. Please allow time in the proposed opening-day schedule for the live tests, retests, and signatures before Hearth makes its opening decision.

Once Hearth sends the sponsor’s written acceptance, venue, check times, time zone, and report deadline, Ivo will confirm availability for both assistant days and the live video session before signing.
